Pawkie,

✧

One thing that’s been on my mind lately is that I’ve realized I’ve never loved someone like this. I’ve never gotten to be myself like this, showing sides of me I didn’t even know existed. You’re such an amazing, butiful, fun, smart, cool gurl. You genuinely brought light into my life. You have made me a better person, you have taught me to love again, and you have shown me that there is still good in this life. I love love love you soo much.

I love your eyes, your smile, YOUR CUTE VOICE, your intelligence, your personality, the way you treat me and others soo well, your manners, your strength, your emotional intelligence, and most importantly, I LOVE YOUUUUU. Even if all those things changed, I would still love you the way I do, cuz my love for you doesn’t depend on them. I can love you for simply being you. So even tho I love all these little things about you, you don’t have to be tough or always positive. You just have to be YOU.

You have one of the cutest and most beautiful faces I have ever seen. Even tho sometimes you think you’re ugly, you’ll always be butiful to my eyes. And it’s not just your face, it’s YOU as a person. I’ve never met someone with your strength and personality. You are soo sweet, so caring, so loving, so YOU.

✧

And I am truly sorry for every single bit of pain I added to your life, every night you slept with a heavy chest cuz of me, every time you had an aching heart cuz of me. Ik I hurt you with my words, and I’m sorry for what I said.

I genuinely can’t believe I have someone like YOU in my life. I never imagined all those years of loneliness would lead me to someone like youuuu.

✧

And remember how, in the beginning, I told you that I love you as a friend to clarify things? That has changed. I love you more now than ever. I didn’t know I could love someone this deeply, so much so that, if the time was right, we would be in the same bed, cuddling and kissing each other, and you would have a butiful ring on your butiful hand. And you deserve the best of the best.

I truly see in you the best partner because, even tho I hurt you and gave you all the reasons to leave, you stayed. You helped me. You insisted that I talk about my problems, even when all I wanted to do was disappear. And I am really thankful to have you in my life, and I rly rly rly love you soo much, deeper than you think.

Ik this message won’t fix everything, but I care enough to at least try. I love you soo much, and I want to show you that with how I treat you, too.

♡

Take your time, okay? I mean what I wrote either way.
